No one escapes from Commander Fox.|Commander Fox|"[[Out Foxed]]"}} '''Fox''', designated '''CC-1010''', was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] of the Grand Army of the Republic and commanded the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Fox assisted [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in the capture of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], the mastermind who kidnapped [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] and uncle to the infamous crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], during the [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club]]. Later, Fox led a squad of the [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] in confronting the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], who was escaping from the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] after [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|taking]] a group of senators hostage and using them to secure Ziro the Hutt's liberation from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]], however, Fox was forced to let the bounty hunters escape along with Ziro. Fox later was assigned to guard the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] and the Coruscant [[Republic military base]]. Fox participated in the [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|chase]] for fugitive [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] who was blamed by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] in the murder of [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]]. ==Biography== ===Clone Commander=== [[File:CommanderFox2.png|thumb|right|180px|Fox in his Phase I armor]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] 1010[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] earned the [[Callsign/Legends|name]] Fox during his training. Like all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]],{{SWE|groups|clonetroopers|clone troopers}} Fox was bred and engineered on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as a soldier to serve the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], a genetic copy of the Mandalorian bounty-hunter [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began, Fox was assigned to lead the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], an elite clone trooper unit tasked with serving as peace-keepers on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].[[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] Fox carried two [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]] in holsters on the sides of his [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' and a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] and also a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]]{{TCW|Hostage Crisis|d=y}} He wore the distinctive crimson color of the Coruscant Guard on his [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and a variation of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] Emblem. On his helmet Fox wore a visor and antennas similar to [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], a fellow Clone Commander. ===Arrest of Ziro the Hutt=== {{Quote|Should we arrest the Hutt, Senator?|Fox, to Senator Amidala, after apprehending Ziro|audio=ShouldWeArrestTheHutt-TCWf.flac|}} [[File:CoruscantGuard-TCWfilm.png|thumb|left|280px|Fox led his Coruscant Guard during the raid on Ziro's palace on Coruscant.]] Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' as [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] captured [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in his [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|palace]], her [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] called Fox for help, prompting Fox to accompany C-3PO to Ziro's palace with his squad of [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] troopers. As Ziro prepared to execute Amidala, Fox's rescue team blasted their way into the palace, destroying the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] guarding the entrance in the process. In the ensuing commotion, Amidala freed herself and destroyed the IG-86 droid guarding her with an appropriated E-5 blaster rifle. After the near-miss of a blaster bolt, Ziro slithered off his dais, making for the exit. Taking cover from return fire, Fox and his troops made quick work of the remaining security droids. After eliminating battle droids, Fox and Amidala arrested Ziro the Hutt and taken him to the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]].{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}{{TCW|Assassin (episode)}} At some point during the Clone Wars, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] put a hefty live [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on all of the senators of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Because almost all of the senators resided on Coruscant, it fell under the jurisdiction of Fox and his men to protect them. One such incident occurred when Fox learned from his spies that a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] was planning to kidnap senator [[Shayla Paige-Tarkin]]. Fox found the hunter but had been ordered to keep him alive. The Trandoshan took off upon seeing Fox, but the Commander knew the streets of Coruscant better than most. He contacted his fellow guards and quickly cornered the bounty hunter. With no where else to go, the Trandoshan blasted his way to the roof of a nearby building with a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]]. Still intent on capturing the Trandoshan, Fox used his [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] to climb up the side of that same building. On the roof, Fox's advances were met with more hostile fire, but was able to shoot the blaster out of the would-be kidnapper's hand and talked him into surrendering. ===Commanding the Coruscant Guard=== {{Quote|Whoa whoa whoa, wait a minute! Power generators are ''that'' way.''"
[Droids go in the right direction]
"''Heh, stupid droids.|Fox is deceived by disguised Separatist demolition droids|{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}}} [[File:FoxFooled-HOBS.png|thumb|right|230px|Commander Fox is fooled by a fake work order by Separatist demolition droids.]] Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] led by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode022.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hostage Crisis}} infiltrated the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] and taken [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] hostage to force [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to free Ziro the Hutt from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]]. As the bounty hunters escaping, Fox led a squad of [[Shock trooper/Legends|Shock troopers]] confronting Bane and his team. Through Fox, Palpatine contacted Bane and ordered him to surrender, but the bounty hunter revealed the still-trapped senators, and in order to keep them safe, Palpatine reluctantly relinquished his attempts to apprehend Bane. Fox ordered his clone forces to stand down, allowing Bane and his team to leave. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Fox went to [[Juma 9]] with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Threepwood/Legends|Threepwood]] to free the station from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], in which he played a crucial role in. Fox was later on duty in the lower levels of Coruscant, checking I.D. when he ran into a group of cleaning droids who, unknown to him, were really [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]] sent to attack the planet by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The falsified work order was authentic enough to fool the commander, who let the droids pass and even pointed the droid impostors in the direction of the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|power generators]] when they were going the wrong way.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' ([[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition) Later in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' Fox{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2012 Basic Figure|pack=#18: Clone Commander Fox (Phase II Armor)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Commander_Fox_TCW_Clone_Wars.asp}} oversaw security at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], brought in the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], who had been arrested after allegedly killing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].{{TCW|Deception}} Fox and his fellow clone trooper brought Hardeen into the prison, unaware that it was actually Kenobi, who was deep undercover to infiltrate a plot to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. ===Hunt for Ahsoka Tano=== {{Quote|Can't say I blame you, Commander Tano, but all the same, you're under arrest.''"
"''I—n-no. I did not do this.|Fox and Ahsoka Tano, after Letta Turmond was killed while Tano was in her cell|{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}}} [[File:AhsokaUnderArrest-TJWKTM.png|thumb|left|260px|Fox places Ahsoka Tano under arrest]] Fox was later put in charge of the security of a large [[Republic military base|military complex]] where, many prisoners including [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] leaders{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-jedi-who-knew-too-much-episode-guide|text="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} were being held. [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]], who had arranged an [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|explosion in the Jedi Temple]],{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}} requested to see Ahsoka Tano. Soon after the two were left alone in the cell, a [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] alerted Fox to the alarming footage on the security cameras; it appeared as though Tano was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|choking]] the prisoner, however, it was [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], who force-chocked Turmond.{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}} Quickly Fox and two other troopers rushed into the cell, only to find Tano, apparently distraught, bending over Turmond's [[Death/Legends|dead]] body. Fox commented that he didn't blame Ahsoka for wanting revenge on a traitor, but all the same he had to put her under arrest. Soon after, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Tano's master, requested to see her. Fox had orders from [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] that nobody was allowed to see her, however, and had two shock troopers activate [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]], threatening to enforce the Admiral's orders with force, before Skywalker would leave. The following day, Tano escaped from prison and had apparently slain at least three clones in order to do so. Fox told his men to shoot to kill, a command that was immediately belayed by [[General/Legends|General]] Skywalker, who insisted they capture her alive. After a lengthy chase around the complex, Tano escaped into the large pipe system leading to the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. Fox and his men quickly gave pursuit, but arrived too late to keep the Padawan from jumping onto a passing ship and escaping.{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}} ===Hunting the fugitive clone=== Fox was later tasked with hunting down rogue clone [[Fives/Legends|CT-5555]] "Fives" after the latter had discovered a [[Grand Plan/Legends|massive conspiracy]] in the Republic government and had been subsequently framed and vilified. When one of his [[Observation droid (Clone Wars)/Legends|probes]] spotted Fives heading into a warehouse, Fox took a squad of shock troopers and headed there. He managed to sneak in undetected, where he found an agitated Fives trying to convince a trapped General Skywalker and [[Rex/Legends|Captain Rex]] of the enormity of the conspiracy. Fox and his squad rushed the rogue clone, who prepared to fire on them in his desperation. Fox fired one lethal shot into Fives' chest. Fox's men took off their helmets as they mourned the dead trooper.{{TCW|Orders (episode)}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Sorry sir, but the Admiral's order stands.|Fox to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|}} As a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], Fox led the [[Shock trooper/Legends|Shock troopers]] guarding the Republic capital. Like every other clone trooper in the Guard, Fox was bound by honor and duty to protect and serve the Supreme Chancellor and the members of the Galactic Senate. He spent little time with Jedi, and his loyalty was first to the Republic. He followed orders swiftly and effectively, never visually questioning them. Utterly fearless, Fox was always the first to lead the charge into battle, even in the most perilous combat situations. His exemplary performance has made him one of the most highly decorated soldiers in the Republic army. ==Equipment== [[File:Clone-commander-fox_detail.png|thumb|110px|Commander Fox in Phase II clone trooper armor]] Fox's [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I armor]] featured crimson markings and emblazoned on his chest was a variation of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] emblem. Fox's helmet was similar to [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224 ("Cody")]], though it sported a dark red color, and as a commander he also wore a [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']] with two blaster holsters, carrying a standard-issue [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] and [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]], two [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]] and a grappling hook. The commander later made the jump to [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II armor]] alongside his unit: his Phase II armor was effectively a reverse of his initial kit as well as the armor of many regular Coruscant Guard troopers, being mostly red with scarce areas of white, and he now sported the Galactic Senate emblem on his shoulder pads. Fox continued to wear a visor atop his helmet, which was fitted with a flashlight and antennae. ==Behind the scenes== Fox should not be confused with a [[Fox (501st Legion)/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] of the same name stationed on Coruscant during the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|raid of the Jedi Temple]]. Fox was first mentioned in toy lines for the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'']] film. In the Swedish translation of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'', Fox's rank is stated to be Överste. Överste is the Swedish word for [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' Fox, like all other clones, was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Clone Wars'' TV series]].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' In the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|junior novelization]] of ''The Clone Wars'' film, a picture of another shock trooper is incorrectly attributed as Fox.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]] Fox's appearance in "[[Hostage Crisis]]" was not verified until its later [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars#The Clone Wars: Decoded|''Decoded'']] re-airing. In addition, his appearance in Phase II armor in the episode "[[Deception]]" was not verified until the release of a Hasbro figure confirming his remodeled look. ==Appearances==
